mesa2018_epidermal_neighbor_fates@1.figure: 3C, fate imbalance among the six nearest cells following a basal-layer differentiation event
mesa2018_epidermal_neighbor_fates@1.interpretation: A fitted time scale for neighboring cell fates. The assay supplies neither the state of an incoming carrier nor its time of arrival at the departing cell's site.

xie2020_paired_epidermal_volumes@1.figure: Supplement page 4, panel labelled S2L in the graphic and cited as S2L in the main text
xie2020_paired_epidermal_volumes@1.extraction: Convert PDF page 4 using pdftocairo -f 4 -l 4 -svg. The orange stroke with eleven M–L segments connects each parent to its daughters. Transform its raw y to page y as 452.1348 minus raw y. Page y values 453.0684 and 517.9707 correspond to 1000 and 600 µm³. Interpolate linearly and round each endpoint to 0.1 µm³.
xie2020_paired_epidermal_volumes@1.uncertainty: The digitized decimal records figure precision. The authors give an overall repeat-segmentation difference of 9.1 ± 8.6%. The paired change spans two imaging frames.
xie2020_paired_epidermal_volumes@1.interpretation: The outgoing volume is a rounded mitotic parent and the incoming volume is the combined volume of both daughters. This measures division. A scheduled one-for-one replacement can have a different volume change.

mitchell2025_extruding_cell_volume@1.preparation: MDCKII epithelial monolayers after a 20% hypertonic shock
mitchell2025_extruding_cell_volume@1.observable: Positive magnitude of cytoplasmic GFP volume loss relative to each cell's baseline
mitchell2025_extruding_cell_volume@1.interpretation: Volume loss in cells classified by their subsequent fate. Absolute incoming volume, exchanged species and mechanical or osmotic work were unmeasured.
